thread:
Ava L: kicked off Rayleigh two-stage decode bringup. TL;DR: ~1.55x end-to-end token throughput, small qual delta on long-form prompts. logs attached.
Ben K: nice. which model/version? quantized?
Ava L: llama3-12b-qlora-4bit + custom lookahead prefetch. Not full spec-decoder; it's a two-stage: fast shallow pass (beam=1, short KV) then deep re-rank on candidates.
Khalid: can you paste the perf numbers?
Ava L: p50 token latency (hosted bench, 2048 context): baseline 120ms -> rayleigh 78ms. p95 420ms -> 310ms. throughput tokens/sec +55% on our inner perf harness.
Maya: quality numbers? BLEU/LM or human eval?
Ava L: automated: perplexity +0.6% (worse), MRR on QA dev set -0.8 pts. But pairwise A/B on 200 samples: judges preferred rayleigh in 42%, baseline in 48%, tie 10%. The regressions concentrate on long reasoning where early-pass prunes useful candidates.
Ben K: sounds like adding a confidence gate could help — abort to deep decode when entropy above threshold.
Khalid: agreed. Also maybe increase shallow pass beamsize to 3 for reasoning prompts, cost tradeoff? Do we have batch-level knobs?
Ava L: ran a quick sweep: beam=3 shallow pass recovers ~70% of degraded cases, latency hit ~+12ms p50. We tried a dynamic beam: if prompt tokens > 600 then beam=3. That hybrid reduces regressions a lot in eval.
prefill-bot: test summary uploaded: s3://redwood-tests/rayleigh/172875/results.tar.gz : snapshot /timeline/commit/abc123
Maya: what's our acceptance criteria for onboard? We need <1% human preference regress and <10% throughput regression vs dedup baseline.
Ben K: propose acceptance: human pref delta > -3% and throughput >= +40%.
Ava L: current run: human pref delta -6% (fail), throughput +55% (pass). Next steps: tune dynamic beam + early-entropy gating, re-run 2k human pairs stratified by prompt type (chat, code, long-reasoning).
Khalid: also run with 8-bit quant and tie-breaker softmax temp 0.9 — we saw calibration shift earlier.
Maya: pls add evaluation checklist to PR and include per-prompt breakdown. Include scripts: ```python scripts/compare_rayleigh.py --gold devset_2k --human --save-metrics``` 
Ava L: will do. I'll spin new sweep tonight, posting results in this thread. cc @Ops for infra bump if we need more GPU hours.
Ops: noted. we can allocate extra slots tomorrow morning.
Ben K: one more ask: add ablation where we disable KV-sharing between passes — to measure false-positive cache effects.
Ava L: added to todo. thanks all :rocket:
